meta.name: Explorer From Another World
meta.description: On a quiet evening in Buetter County, a string of strange events lead an eclectic professor, local law enforcement, and a ragtag group of teenagers to search for answers among the missing persons, maimed animals, and flashing lights in the night sky. The residents must band together to stop whoever — or whatever — is committing these troubling acts. However, they have yet to find out that “its” preternatural behavior is far from random…
